notes: Long-weekend role factors refine the generic Bengaluru long-weekend pattern. They are travel-time multipliers against the normal same-weekday/time baseline, not literal traffic-volume changes. Event-specific overrides are used only where historical evidence is strong enough; otherwise the generic profile is retained.

evidence.note: Bengaluru Traffic Police describes strong inner-city relief during long weekends, heavier outbound movement before the break and a Sunday-evening return surge.

eventOverrides.reason: Varamahalakshmi long-weekend evidence shows an unusually strong Bengaluru exodus/at-home effect continuing beyond the festival day, followed by a return-to-city surge.

evidence.note: Reports unusually empty Bengaluru roads during Varamahalakshmi.
Documents the return-to-Bengaluru surge after the Independence Day/Varamahalakshmi long weekend.
